India-Panama Football Friendly Rescheduled in Bengaluru

The international friendly football match between India and Panama, scheduled to be held in Bengaluru, has been advanced by one day. The match will now take place on September 25. Reports indicate the rescheduling is due to a marathon event also planned in Bengaluru. The original date for the friendly was September 26.
